name: LAPIS ALBUS
key_symptoms: Persistent pains in mammary region. Glandular hardening.
guiding_symptoms: Persistent pains in mammary region. Glandular hardening.
head_symptoms: Otitis media suppurativa. Where Silica is indicated progress is hastened by Lapis (Bellows).
respiratory_symptoms: Persistent pains in mammary region. Glandular hardening.
skin_symptoms: Scrofulous abscesses and sores. Enlargement and induration of glands, especially cervical. Lipoma, sarcoma, carcinoma. Pruritus.

source.title: LAPIS ALBUS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
